_arena: 120 px of inset holds her body inside x 520..680 of screen (1,1) -- cols 32..42 of levels/deeps_5.json. The two luminous walls start at col 43 (x 688), so she can never be stopped by one and can never follow Kaya into a brood cell.
_dark: She is drawn at `dark_alpha` on every frame she is not attacking, and at full on every frame she is. `reveal_time` is how long the fade back takes after an attack ends, so the slam does not blink out the instant the wave leaves her. Breaking a luminous wall lifts the floor: see `glow`.
_glow: The rectangle of levels/deeps_5.json the luminous walls stand in, and the tile id that IS one (214, shared `luminous_wall`). src/enemies/brood_queen.gd counts how many of them are still there; every one the PLAYER breaks lifts her base visibility and kills the ambience pool bound to that tile. She never puts one back.
_spore: The spore fall is thrown from the arena's top interior row, so a shot over a comb is born inside solid earth and dies on the frame it is born. That is what makes the six floor tiles under the two combs the only dodge it has.
_cues: What she emits instead of being visible. `crawl_cue` is the ripple of earth at her feet while she crawls -- particles are drawn over the darkness, so her position is always readable even when her body is not. `rumble_*` is the line of dust that runs ahead of the burrow charge during the windup.
